A partially cleaned list of most commonly occurring German words, based on the Wortschatz Leipzig 2011 Mixed typical, 2017 Web (EU), 2019 Web public (Austria, Switzerland, Germany, respectively) and 2021 German Wikipedia 1M sentence corpora, available for public download courtesy of Universität Leipzig / Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften / InfAI, 2023.[1] See suggestions for how to use these lists.
While creating entries for words, please leave valid bluelinks in place as these pages may be copied for use with other language projects in the future.
